title: Thai Pilaf with Vermicelli
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai pilaf dish made with vermicelli pasta, energetic and lively spices, and a hint of Russian flair.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the lively spice blend and energizing chili flakes, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and vermicelli pasta, and stir well to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the Russian dill and season with salt and pepper to taste.
